data.narrative:
Aventra is a Seed-stage Defense & Security company founded by a team with deep US military and cyber expertise—CEO Michael Weigand (ex-Shift5, West Point CS, Army Airborne/Ranger), CFO Brian Retherford (Army Cyber, MIT Sloan), and CRO Jessup Meng (Army Cyber, UW Foster). The company has raised $3M to date. The relevant comp universe spans 10 private and 2 public Defense & Security firms at Seed and Series A stages, including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, and NODA AI.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using $3M raised as a baseline proxy and applying a typical 2.5x Seed-to-next-stage multiplier, implies a valuation of $8M. Peer-median analysis across three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables—UFORCE ($1.0B Seed), Singularity ($400M Series A), and NODA AI ($125M Series A)—yields a median of $400M, with a range spanning $125M to $1.0B. The wide dispersion reflects heterogeneous outcomes within this cohort.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $6M to $460M, with a median of $204M. The significant gap between stage-progression ($8M) and peer-median ($400M) reflects uncertainty about Aventra's positioning within an exceptionally broad peer distribution. Key uncertainties include revenue trajectory, customer traction, and whether the company's technical capabilities and founder pedigree warrant valuation closer to the $400M+ tier or the bootstrap-adjusted lower bound.
